sg_research_rank = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sg_enabled }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_1_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_1_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_score value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sg_research_infrastructure = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { sg_research_available_railways = yes }
				set_variable = { name = sg_research_candidate_id value = 1570967808 }
				set_variable = { name = sg_research_candidate_score value = 90 }
				sg_research_insert = yes
			}
		}
		remove_variable = sg_research_candidate_id
		remove_variable = sg_research_candidate_score
	}
}

sg_research_insert = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sg_research_candidate_score > var:sg_research_1_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_id value = var:sg_research_2_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_score value = var:sg_research_2_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_id value = var:sg_research_1_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_score value = var:sg_research_1_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_1_id value = var:sg_research_candidate_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_1_score value = var:sg_research_candidate_score }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sg_research_candidate_score > var:sg_research_2_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_id value = var:sg_research_2_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_score value = var:sg_research_2_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_id value = var:sg_research_candidate_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_2_score value = var:sg_research_candidate_score }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sg_research_candidate_score > var:sg_research_3_score }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_id value = var:sg_research_candidate_id }
		set_variable = { name = sg_research_3_score value = var:sg_research_candidate_score }
	}
}
